stop: Stop after the decide canary plus main grid: they give table T4 (decision metrics per probe policy on T1) and decide whether decision-EVOI beats fixed/EIG/EPIG per probe-second (docs/board/decision.md).
_doc: Role decision. Task cfcap/decide/task.py:TASK via --task-spec: nuisance_post SMC on v2 (same episodes as nuis-main with --nseed 1909), 64 draws pushed through T1 capability (rho_dec = rho_abs / nominal healthy rho_ref) for children + 10 merges, plus per-draw predictions of clamp / tug / moddiff and one diagnostic split per child. Output decide_eps/*.pkl per unit; the policy evaluation is offline on CPU (scripts/decide_t1_eval.py). unit_s are ESTIMATES from the local 4070 smoke (2 pair episodes, 64 particles, 16 draws, 40 stages: SMC 132 s + probes/labels 16 s per episode, GPU shared), scaled to 192 particles batched 4 per unit and to larger parents (pair 150 / square 300 / 2x3 500 s, mean ~320 s/episode); the canary measures it (unit sidecar meta.smc_s_mean, probe_s_mean). Inputs: the stage as every cfcap job.

groups.name: decide-canary
groups.pilot: local 4070 smoke /tmp/decide_smoke: python -m cfcap.runner decide --task-spec cfcap.decide.task:TASK --shapes pair --episodes 2 --per-unit 2 --particles 64 --draws 16 --max-stages 40 -> exit 0, 148 s/episode (SMC 132 s, probes+labels 16 s), peak VRAM 0.13 GB
groups.purpose: Canary for the T1 decision-episode task on a rented 3090: one unit per parent shape, measuring seconds per episode for SMC, probe predictions and labels.

groups.name: decide-main
groups.pilot: local 4070 smoke as decide-canary (148 s/episode pair at 64 particles); 72 units (3 shapes x 24 units x 4 episodes = 288 episodes) at ~320 s/episode -> ~1300 s/unit; replace by the canary's measured unit wall
groups.purpose: T1 decision episodes with posterior draws and probe predictions for table T4: unsafe-commit, useful-commit, abstention, regret and probe time per policy (fixed v2, random, EIG, EPIG, EVOI, always split).
